findings.current: If I died, they’d remember me, too.
findings.defect: Changes the consequence of Jin’s death from the Hunters dying as well to the Hunters remembering him.
findings.rationale: 그들 역시 그러할 refers to dying, not remembering Jin.
findings.replacement: If I died, they would, too.
findings.source: 내가 죽는다면 그들 역시 그러할 테니.

findings.current: who’d led his forces to victory in more than a dozen major battles
findings.defect: Changes approximately ten battles to more than twelve.
findings.rationale: 십여 차례 indicates roughly ten occasions, not more than a dozen.
findings.replacement: who’d led his forces to victory in around a dozen major battles
findings.source: 그 속에서 십여 차례의 대규모 전투를 승리로 이끈

findings.current: So did Yamamoto Genji, an S-rank Hunter in name and deed, and Team Leader Choi, whose Qi Sense was nearly as sharp.
findings.defect: “In name and deed” asserts proven S-rank ability where the narration only invokes Yamamoto’s nominal status.
findings.rationale: 명색이 invokes Yamamoto’s standing despite his shortcomings; it does not endorse his skill.
findings.replacement: So did Yamamoto Genji, an S-rank Hunter at least in name, and Team Leader Choi, whose Qi Sense was nearly as sharp.
findings.source: 명색이 S급 헌터라 할 수 있는 야마모토 겐지와 그에 버금갈 만큼 예리한 기감을 지닌 최 팀장도 얼굴을 굳혔다.

findings.current: “Watch the air and focus on protecting our allies. The Hunters under your command will follow your orders until I give further instructions.”
findings.defect: Turns an order to keep airborne enemies in check into observation, and presumes the Hunters are already under Johnson’s command.
findings.rationale: 견제 calls for countering or containing the aerial threat; the second sentence assigns the Hunters to follow Johnson’s orders.
findings.replacement: “Keep the enemies in the air in check and focus on protecting our allies. All subordinate Hunters are to follow Magic Johnson’s orders until I give them another command.”
findings.source: 공중을 견제하고 아군 보호에 주력한다. 예하 헌터들은 내 명령이 떨어지기 전까지 매직 존슨의 지시에 따르도록.

findings.defect: Presents a monster’s shouted command as a System notification.
findings.rationale: The following sentence identifies this as Demon Realm language roared by an S-rank monster, not a System message.
findings.source: - 인. 간. 들. 을. 죽. 여. 라!
